runs.text: Beyond The Black - Break The Silence

German symphonic metal band BEYOND THE BLACK have become one of the most exciting forces in modern symphonic metal. It started with their debut album in 2015: Songs Of Love And Death was an instant success. Its successor Lost In Forever (2016) entered the German charts.
With the release of their third album Heart Of The Hurricane, they launched their first European headline tour in fall 2019. The band returned to the studio soon after and in June 2020 released the highly anticipated Horizons.
After the pandemic-induced break, their self-titled fifth album BEYOND THE BLACK dropped in January 2023, charting in several countries and marking a new career high.
The excitement continues as BEYOND THE BLACK launch their next European headline tour, Rising High, kicking off in January 2026, tied with the release of their highly anticipated sixth studio album Break The Silence.
